EmailTemplate.name: NCIAS | Psychology MS | Waitlist Email
EmailTemplate.subject: Psychology MS Application Update
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
We have received your application and have had the chance to review it thoroughly. We were quite impressed with your credentials; however, given the large number of high quality applicants and the limited number of slots, we currently cannot offer you admission into the MS Psychology program.
Instead, we would like to place you on a waitlist. If a slot opens up, we will extend an offer of admission to you at that time.
If you no longer wish to be considered for admission, please let us know as soon as possible in order to allow other waitlisted applicants the opportunity to move up on the list.
If you have any questions about the process, please do not hesitate to contact me. Kristin D. Mickelson, Ph.D. Professor of Psychology & Director of MS Psychology Program School of Social and Behavioral Sciences Arizona State University 4701 W. Thunderbird Rd, FAB S141B Mail Code 3051 Glendale, AZ 85306-4908
Phone: (602) 543-1632 Fax: (602) 543-6004 Email: Kristin.Mickelson@asu.edu
Lab Website: https://sites.google.com/site/kmickelsonsrhlab/
